scope: Consolidation of architecture reference pages into existing full explanations; not a new full pedagogical acceptance of every source paper.
readMethod: Every listed reference and target canonical chapter was read in full. Existing English self-attention chapter was read in full before its figure-only edit. Source papers were not all reread; existing source-based chapter reviews are not silently promoted to current pedagogical acceptance.
